notes: Adobe publishes no state or per-country headcounts. The FY2024 CSR data tables give employees only as U.S. vs. outside-U.S. (50/50) and workspace as U.S. 62% / India 23% / rest of world 14% (sums to 99% as printed). The U.S. appears twice in 'countries', once per metric, because the two figures sit in different table rows. The CSR PDF on adobe.com returned 403 to curl; it was fetched this session through the WebFetch tool and read with pdftotext. Sites: San Jose HQ and the two Indian offices from 10-K Item 2; the owned Hillsboro, OR data center from the CSR environmental table. The 10-K's revenue-by-region shares (Americas/EMEA/APAC) are deliberately not repeated.
